## Script Details

### Name
<!-- The display name of the script (e.g., "Node Version Manager", "Bun") -->

### Category
<!-- e.g., "Development Tools", "Shell", "Package Manager", "DevOps" -->

### Description
<!-- A brief description of what this script installs and its purpose -->

### Installation Command
<!-- The curl/bash command to install. Example: curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash -->

### Source URL
<!-- Link to the official repository or documentation -->

### Installation Script URL
<!-- Link to the raw script file, or indicate if it should be added to the /installs directory -->

## Verification

Please confirm:
- [ ] Script has been tested locally
- [ ] Script is from an official or trusted source
- [ ] Installation command works without requiring user input
- [ ] Script is compatible with common Unix-like systems (macOS, Linux)
- [ ] Description is clear and concise
